input.subject: Preventive Maintenance Push — not closeable yet; my QC sign-off does not hold
input.body:
Brooke,

Before I put my name to closing out the Preventive Maintenance Push, I went back through Linear, Airtable and the field notes and reconciled our records to what's actually on the ground. The end-of-June target has passed and my read is clear: this is not closeable yet, and I want to be straight with you about my own QC piece rather than leave it ambiguous.

Bottom line on QC: my earlier sign-off does NOT hold. The one thing that genuinely passes is the filter-replacement spot-check (OPS-96, filters only). My South+North HVAC sign-off from late May was premature and I've retracted it (OPS-98 / OPS-87), and the East cluster was recorded as "QC passed" when I never actually inspected it. So please do not treat my QC as a green light for closing.

Cluster by cluster — what's open, who holds it, and what has to happen before it can close:

NORTH — not complete.
- What's open: Two units I flagged on my 5/23 walk-through as needing HVAC right away (coil/plumbing/panel). There's no record they were remediated, yet the cluster was marked Done 5/18 and I signed it clean 5/25. I've reopened OPS-40 and retracted that sign-off.
- Owner: John Smith (execution). Logged as maintenance ticket MT-2026-1327.
- To close: tech onsite to repair both units, then QC re-inspection passes.

SOUTH — electrical done, plumbing open.
- Electrical panel inspections are complete and documented (Patricia) — I marked OPS-186 Done.
- What's open: two water heaters flagged for replacement plus hose bibs needing repair (Carlos, 5/31; the water heaters were also your budget-priority flag on 6/3).
- Owner: John Smith (execution), flagged by Carlos. Logged as MT-2026-1328.
- To close: water heaters replaced and hose bibs repaired, then QC re-inspection passes.

EAST — service done, QC never performed.
- Elias finished coil cleaning/filters and moved it to In Review for QC on 5/28–5/30. OPS-99/OPS-108 say the East QC "passed" and that I confirmed it — that is not accurate; I never ran it. I've raised OPS-1000 (owned by me) for the outstanding East QC and corrected those two issues (they're also duplicates of each other).
- Also open: HVAC run follow-ups Elias flagged — two recurring condensate drains + one compressor to re-check — logged as MT-2026-1329 (owner: Elias).
- To close: I run the East QC spot-check and it passes; condensate/compressor items cleared.

WEST — still in progress.
- Owner: Lisa (onsite lead) with John (execution). OPS-35 is still In Progress; it hasn't been presented for QC, so there's nothing for me to check yet.
- To close: Lisa confirms completion at each West property and hands it to QC for a spot-check.

Next step on my end: I've booked a QC re-inspection for Wed 7/9 (9–11 AM) to re-check the three field tickets above and East once it's presented. I'll need each owner to confirm their work is done before then.
